name: Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, July 05, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting Minutes of June 21, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2016-32 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Amend an agreement with Siemens Industry, Inc. for Traffic Signal Maintenance Services
ACTION: 1) Amend an Agreement for Traffic Signal maintenance services with Siemens Industry, Inc. to include a 1.7% CIP Increase and 2) authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.
Item #7d
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF A ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT AND CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT ASSOCIATED ENTITLEMENTS FOR A NEW STARBUCKS DRIVE-THRU CAFÉ LOCATED AT 1730-1734 PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Ord 780 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Zone Text Amendment No. 2015-04 amending Section 11-1.48.04 (Uses by Conditional Use Permit) to permit drive-thru uses within the Commercial Retail Zone subject to a Conditional Use Permit filed by Starbucks Coffee Company, c/o Charlie Arbing, 17700 Newhope Street, Fountain Valley, CA 92708 (First Reading)
1)
Introduce first reading of an ordinance amending Section 11-1.48.04 of the LMC to permit drive-thru uses within the Commercial-Retail zone subject to a conditional use permit; and
2)
Adopt two resolutions approving Conditional Use Permit No. 298 and Negative Declaration No. 2016-01 to allow a new 850 square foot Starbucks drive-thru only with outdoor dining and associated signage.
Item #8
9.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 299 AND TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 073720, FOR A MIXED-USE PROJECT CONSISTING OF 8,325 SQUARE FEET OF COMMERCIAL AREA AND 20 TOWNHOUSE UNITS
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res 2016-35 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Conditional Use Permit No. 299 for the development of a proposed Mixed-Use Project consisting of 8,326 square feet of commercial area, 20 townhouse units, and 61 parking spaces located at 25114-25118 Narbonne Avenue in the C-G, Commercial General Zone. Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3453 Newridge Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.
Res 2016-36 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Tentative Tract Map No. 073720 for the development of a proposed Mixed-Use Project consisting of 8,325 square feet of commercial area, 20 townhouse units, and 61 parking spaces located at 25114-25118 Narbonne Avenue, in the CG, Commercial General Zone. Filed by Cherine Medawar, 3453 Newridge Drive, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275.
1)
Adopt resolutions approving Conditional Use Permit No. 299 and Tentative Tract Map No. 073720, to permit a mixed-use project consisting of 8,325 square feet of commercial area, 20 townhouse units, and 61 parking spaces located at 25024 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street, in the C-G Commercial General Zone.
10.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONFIRMATION OF A LIEN FOR THE COLLECTION OF NUISANCE ABATEMENT COSTS FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 26011 CAYUGA AVENUE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita ordering the recordation of an abatement lien against the property located at 26011 Cayuga Avenue, Lomita (APN 7553-016-001) in the amount of $7,372.25 and permitting the collection of interest in the amount of seven percent per year.
ACTION: That the matter be continued off calendar.
Item #10
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
11.
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF A PUBLIC WORKS AGREEMENT TO ROY ALLAN SLURRY SEAL, INC. FOR THE FY 2016-17 SLURRY SEAL PROGRAM
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Award a Public Works Agreement to Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc. in the amount of $443,542.56 for the FY 2016-17 Slurry Seal Program; and
2)
Approve a total contract budget of $487,896.82 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions; and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement.
Item #11
12.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, July 19, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
